newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- Feb 14.

text.p: * Micron Technology Inc shares were up 1/4 at 33-1/8 in after-hours trading Thursday following a late afternoon forecast by the company that it would record a second quarter gain from a secondary offering for Micron Electronics Inc.
* High tech stocks continued to advance in London, with International Business Machines Corp up 1/4 at 146-3/8 and Intel Corp up 1/4 at 157-1/4.

* Contract talks between AMR Corp's American Airlines and its pilots union continued into the early hours of Friday morning, with neither side reporting any breakthrough that would avert a midnight strike at the No. 2 U.S. carrier. AMR closed at 83-1/8 Thursday.
